title: 3Sum
problem statement:
Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j, i != k, and j != k, and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0.

Notice that the solution set must not contain duplicate triplets.
approach: We sort the array then iterate over it, and then for each iteration it becomes a 2sum problem and we use a similar approach as explained [here](../two_sum_2/README.md)
